heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Which channels can the chatbot run on?
items.answer: Websites, WhatsApp, Messenger and mobile apps, depending on your needs.

items.question: Will it understand natural language?
items.answer: Yes. We use language models and intent recognition to handle everyday phrasing.

items.question: Can it hand over to a human?
items.answer: Yes. Conversations can be escalated to your team with full context.

items.question: How long does chatbot development take?
items.answer: A focused system can go live in 8 to 12 weeks, while larger multi-department platforms take 4 to 9 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
